supplementalViews.sourceName: BC Ministry of Health via BCCDC / PHSA Community Health Data
supplementalViews.timeLabel: FY 2001–2002 through FY 2020–2021 · CHSA v2018 · retrieved 12 October 2026
notes: Supplementary public measurements retrieved directly from BCCDC/PHSA on 12 October 2026. They were not present as CHSA scientific rows in the collected Zoer C016 CSV; C016 only supplies related inventory context.

Native CHSA identifiers, names and hierarchy match the source profile’s 2018 boundary configuration. The map uses the archived Ministry geometry mirrored by Community Map of Canada, not PGMaps current 2022 polygons. McBride/Valemount remains one 2018 area; its value is not split between later McBride and Valemount areas.

The two views retain eight original indicators, Total only, over FY 2001.2002 through FY 2020.2021. A normalized display period retains the fiscal duration. October 2026 retrieval does not make these rates current.

Rates use the 2011 Canadian Census population for age standardization. They are published administrative-registry measures per 1,000, not raw cases or crude percentages. Incidence and lifetime prevalence have separate definitions, retained with the original notes and further-information link.

Asthma and diabetes use ages 1+, COPD ages 35+, and hypertension ages 20+. Different age universes limit cross-condition rankings. Select one indicator and fiscal period for one value per CHSA; rates are not additive across places or conditions.

The database download omits 187 potential indicator/year cells among the 29 listed Northern CHSAs. Six latest missing cells have explicit profile CSV dashes and remain null; other absent historical cells remain absent. The dash does not specify its particular non-release reason. Neither omissions nor unreleased communities are assigned zero.

Forty Northern v2018 context polygons include 29 publicly listed measured CHSAs. The portal excludes publicly identifiable Indigenous CHSAs; no restricted values are requested or reconstructed. This public subset cannot supply a complete Northern total.

The source warns that small numerator or denominator counts can create volatility and obscure trends. Confidence intervals are not provided in these downloads. Rates do not establish trial eligibility, service demand, causal changes or NHHR effects, and are not multiplied by population projections to infer cases.

Database rates retain their reported one-decimal precision. The 226 reported latest cells reconcile with the higher-precision profile literals within the source rounding interval; those profile literals are verification evidence rather than replacement series values.

reviews.summary: All six original ZIP CSV and metadata sources were inspected: ER labour, ER and CMA industry/occupation employment, provincial occupation wages, CMA building permits and country/industry FDI. The newer ER labour view retains monthly three-month moving averages.
reviews.mapConnection: Six exact 2021 ER DGUIDs join native polygons. North Coast and Nechako use one verified union of PGMaps ERs 5960 and 5970, consistent with the publisher’s combined LFS reporting geography. Its source DGUID remains blank.
needs: CMA records require exact CMA geometry, not city points. Older 2016 ER series remain separate and chart-only.
cannot: Moving averages overlap and cannot be summed. Provincial wages, CMA permits and country/industry FDI cannot be assigned to Northern hospital catchments.

supplementalReviews.inspectionScope: Actual PHSA public API location/topic/indicator metadata; 29 location-specific scientific CSV downloads; 29 source-profile CSVs; primary v2018 profiles and map images for 5242/5246; archived 40-polygon Northern display geometry and current PGMaps v2022 comparison. No restricted CHSAs, individual cases or patient records were queried.

reviewDetails.nativeGrain: CHSA × original indicator × fiscal period × Total
reviewDetails.profilePrecisionMethod: Source database one-decimal rates agree with higher-precision profile values within 0.05001; profile numbers are verification evidence and do not replace the source series.
reviewDetails.publicOmissions: The portal excludes publicly identifiable Indigenous CHSAs. Source CSV omissions remain absent; six latest source profile dashes are retained as null without assigning an unstated suppression reason.
reviewDetails.identifierMethod: CDR2022 is the stable PHSA source string used in exact download values. Returned topic/indicator GUIDs change per request; semantic metadata checks exclude them but retain original byte receipts.

geometry.licenseScope: Mapping and visualization only. No downstream spatial analysis, area-weighted allocation or population inference.
geometry.legacyOfficialZipStatus: HTTP 404; not used as verified source
profileEraVerification: All 29 public IDs/names/native hierarchy match the archived Northern geometry.
PHSA 5242 and 5246 introductions and map images explicitly identify v2018; archive area checks agree with rounded primary descriptions.
McBride/Valemount code 5246 retains the combined historical area; no later 5248 polygon is added.

reuse.scope: The portal provides customizable CSV downloads for users’ own reports and planning. PHSA general terms permit copying/distribution for personal and non-commercial health-care purposes with source/copyright notices, and restrict modification of copied documents/graphics. This release retains numerical facts and source literals, references primary definitions, includes source attribution/URLs in records and exports, and reproduces no portal graphics. Long definition prose is normalized once per indicator, with primary links; no open-government license is claimed for the PHSA text. Geometry has a separate OGL-BC and display-only limitation.
